instruction: Enable incremental search in Vim by adding the appropriate setting to my Vim configuration file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Vim incremental search. Verifies ~/.vimrc contains uncommented 'set incsearch' command.
metadata.verification: Script verifies Vim configuration file for specific settings. Uses grep to check ~/.vimrc content.
